svg.title: Parallel Lantern — conditions atlas
svg.desc: Verdict: Keep both routes reversible. 6 work items grouped by period and lane against 8 parallel decisions. 5 work items have authored conditions. Columns do not imply sequence. Selected decision Pricing. Current state: Unanswered — overdue since 2026-08-10.

g.text: Every item once. Read across to see exactly what must be true.
YES / NO appears only where an outcome matters.
